Title: Old English Core Vocabulary
Description: List of list c. 600 Old English literary core vocabulary words. Created by Christine Rauer (University of St Andrews).

Title: Old English Core Vocabulary St Andrews Flashcards
Description: Digital flashcards of OE core vocabulary with free access on Quizlet.Created by Christine Rauer (University of St Andrews).

Title: Old English Grammar Bytes
Description: Bite-size videos on Old English grammar, specifically cases, adjectives, verbs and nouns. Created by Thijs Porck (Leiden University)

Title: Old English Martyrology: An Annotated Bibliography
Description: Bibliography of publications on the Old English Martyrology. Created by Christine Rauer (University of St Andrews).

Title: Teachers of Old English in Britain and Ireland (TOEBI)
Description: A society for everyone involved in teaching Old English in Britain and Ireland. TOEBI organizes annual conferences and publishes a newsletter.

Title: Electronic Beowulf
Description: Electronic Beowulf is a digital edition of Beowulf closely based on its unique manuscript in British Library MS Cotton Vitellius A xv. The edition provides access to the poem and strategies for studying it in ways unavailable to print editions. The fifth edition allows scholars, students, and general readers, each with different interests and requirements, to customize the edition with ease. Created by Kevin Kiernan and Emi Iacob
